report_name: West of England Local Cycling and Walking Infrastructure Plan
other_tools_developed: Cycling and Walking Early Assessment Sifting Tool
specific_evidence_of_impact: The document cites several specific impacts: the Baldwin Street segregated cycle route saw cycle trips increase from 890 to nearly 3,000 per day in 2019; the Brean Down Way route carried at least 44,000 cycle and 30,000 pedestrian trips in 2018; and the Whitehouse Street project increased pedestrian footfall from 859 to 1,628 trips post-scheme.
local_authority_name: Bath & North East Somerset, Bristol City, South Gloucestershire, North Somerset Council
